method.random_reject: 40 drawn uniformly without replacement from all 1061 rejects (first use of the PRNG)
method.closest_call: the 15 scored, non-vetoed postings with the smallest |score - threshold| (threshold 0.8); ties by board:id
method.rows: one row per posting; a posting in several strata appears once and counts in each; row order shuffled with the same PRNG
method.pm_reject: 15 drawn uniformly without replacement (seed 20261126 = audit seed + 1) from the 133 rejects whose title matches /\bproduct\b|\bprogram manager\b/i, excluding the 55 rows already on the audit sheet and the 40 label-sheet postings; appended as rows after A055 in sampled order
